applicabilityBasis.summary: AUDC Pty Ltd issues AUDD for payment and settlement with an obligation to redeem each token for AUD1, backed by segregated AUD cash held on bare trust. Fixed redemption in a non-USD national currency meets the apparent payment-stablecoin profile.

genius.notes: Review as of 2026-10-07: AUDC Pty Ltd discloses AFSL 700123 and an AUD1 holder-redemption obligation. No issuer-specific GENIUS approval, application or foreign registration was located. The issuer Coinbase announcement describes global distribution without substantiating the prior U.S. trading-restriction/custody-only distinction, which is removed. The Coinbase-operated blog was blocked during independent verification and is not retained as evidence. Novatti and AUDC commentary discuss GENIUS policy context without announcing a U.S. application. Monthly William Buck AUP reports extend through 30 September 2026, signed 5 October; the engagement provides factual findings without an assurance opinion. Treasury FR 2026-06489 concerns state-regime similarity. GENIUS offer/sale restrictions remain prospective under the opened Treasury section 3 proposal.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the opened federal/state rulemaking materials, OCC pending-applications table, issuer disclosures and issuer-name regulatory searches did not identify a GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified status, official pending application, registered foreign exception or issuer-announced GENIUS application plan for AUDC Pty Ltd / AUDD. Search and table coverage are limited public negative evidence; no authorization or enforcement absence is certified. Australian licensing does not establish a U.S. pathway.
